source.citation: Tamarapalli, Grover, Pande, Yerramilli. CountQA: How Well Do MLLMs Count in the Wild? arXiv:2508.06585 (2025). Dataset Jayant-Sravan/CountQA, CC-BY-4.0.

id_scheme: countqa_<row index across sorted parquet shards, 4 digits>_<sha256(image bytes)[:8]>; question rows append _q<k> (index in the release questions list)
selection: is_focused rows only; one target object and one question per image; deterministic rules first, then the recorded agent review (question text only, not a human review); the first surviving question in release order is kept

reasons.duplicate_image_conflicting_answers: rule: identical image bytes appear in several rows whose answers to the same question disagree
reasons.duplicate_image: rule: identical image bytes in an earlier kept row
reasons.non_integer_answer: rule: answer is not a non-negative integer
reasons.zero_answer: rule: answer is 0, so no instance exists to box
reasons.combination: rule: sums or unions across object types or subsets (and/or/combined/...)
reasons.comparison: rule: comparison or arithmetic between counts
reasons.location_qualifier: rule: location, foreground/background or side qualifier
reasons.part_of_qualifier: rule: part-of or container phrase (on/in/of/with the ...)
reasons.attribute_qualifier: rule: material, size, orientation or shape adjective
reasons.generic_target: rule: target is a generic word such as objects
reasons.unparsed_question_form: rule: not of the form 'How many X are there/visible' or 'What is the (total) number of X'
reasons.agent_subtype_selection: agent review: asks for a subtype (brand, card suit, card kind, towel kind) of objects that the question set shows co-occur in the image
reasons.agent_mixed_category: agent review: target is a category spanning several object types
reasons.agent_part_of_qualifier: agent review: compound noun restating a part-of qualifier
reasons.not_selected_one_question_per_image: selection: another eligible question on this image comes first in release order
reasons.no_eligible_question: image: no question on this image survives the rules and review

agent_review.reviewer: agent review (Claude, question text only; no images viewed; not human review)
